'''Travel passpads''' were a form of identification used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They could be [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forged]]. An [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] team deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] were supplied with fake travel passpads.<ref name="The Ando Project" />
